ae_match_explanation: Maculopapular rash covering >30% BSA with areas of confluence, consistent with Grade 3 immune-related dermatitis.

ctcae_grade_visual.ctcae_descriptor: Macules/papules covering >30% BSA with or without associated symptoms; limiting self-care ADL

caveats: SJS/TEN must be excluded — urgent dermatology and oncology consultation required.
